purpose: This table provides cleaned hourly weather observations for NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA), feeding downstream flight-delay and airport-operations analytics that join weather conditions to flight records by origin and hour.
usage: Consumers should join on origin and time_hour to align weather with flight data; wind_gust, pressure, wind_dir, and wind_speed may be null and must be explicitly handled (coalesced, filtered, or flagged) rather than assumed present in every row.
limitations: wind_gust is missing in 74.6% of rows (9702 of 13014) and pressure is missing in 11.5% of rows (1496 of 13014); these gaps were not imputed and remain nullable. wind_dir (1.68%) and wind_speed (0.015%) carry minor residual nulls retained as-is. The dataset covers only year 2013 (distinct_count 1) and should not be used to infer multi-year trends.
